summary: Destroys a linked list whose head lives at this+0x0. While the head is non-null, walks the node chain through the next pointer at node+0x4. For each node with a non-zero flag byte at node+0x8, runs SEHGuardedFunctionWithExceptionHandling on the node's data pointer (node+0x0) and frees that data via FreeWrapper_7bcf when the pointer is non-null. Every node object itself is then freed via FreeWrapper_7bcf. After the walk, clears the list head (this+0x0), tail (this+0x4), iterator (this+0x8) and count (this+0xC) fields to 0 and returns 0. Called by sub_583AE0 (00583AE0).
